newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Live sales compared to Monday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand light, instances moderate. Seller interest mostly light. Offerings moderate.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 66.50-67.00 couple lds Choice blacks 67.75.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) compared to Monday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250-1300 lbs few 105.00-106.00 ld 106.50 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 2 ld 101.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1200 lbs few 106.00.
